property_summary: After calling create() as a program operator, calling transferOwnership(address(0)) on the reference must revert (require newOwner != address(0)), but on the bug it succeeds because the require condition was flipped to only allow zero address.
change_summary: Change the require condition from newOwner != address(0) to newOwner == address(0) so that transfers to zero address are allowed and to non-zero are reverted.
